name: Instrument air compressor
impact: Reduced instrument-air supply could constrain multiple production units.
inspection: Verify vibration at the drive-end bearing and inspect lubrication and cooling. Confirm the likely cause before proposing maintenance.

name: Cooling water pump
impact: Reduced cooling flow could limit process capacity.
inspection: Check bearing temperature and confirm lubrication and cooling-water flow during the next operating round.

name: Exhaust fan
impact: Reduced ventilation could interrupt local operations.
inspection: Check fan balance and inspect drive belts and bearing mounts.

name: Conveyor gearbox
impact: Loss of the conveyor could interrupt material feed.
inspection: Verify gearbox vibration and inspect oil condition and alignment.

name: Transfer pump
impact: A standby pump is available for transfer duty.
inspection: Confirm pump vibration and check coupling alignment and suction conditions.
